rune_ascent:Name: Fuse Runes
rune_ascent:Result: 1 rune, the next one up the ladder (the 3 runes are used up)
rune_ascent:Makes: 1 rune, the next one up the ladder
rune_ascent:Keeps: nothing - only the new rune comes out
rune_kindled:Name: Kindled Ascent
rune_kindled:Recipe: 2 identical Tier I-II runes + any jewel
rune_kindled:Result: 1 rune, the next one up the ladder (the 2 runes and the jewel are used up)
rune_kindled:Makes: 1 rune, the next one up the ladder
rune_kindled:Keeps: nothing - only the new rune comes out
rune_tempered:Name: Tempered Ascent
rune_tempered:Recipe: 3 identical Tier III runes + a Faceted or Radiant jewel
rune_tempered:Result: 1 rune, the next one up the ladder (the runes and the jewel are used up)
rune_tempered:Makes: 1 rune, the next one up the ladder
rune_tempered:Keeps: nothing - only the new rune comes out
rune_dawnbinding:Name: Dawnbinding
rune_dawnbinding:Recipe: 3 identical Tier IV runes + a Faceted or Radiant jewel
rune_dawnbinding:Result: 1 Tier V rune, the next one up the ladder (the runes and the jewel are used up)
rune_dawnbinding:Makes: 1 Tier V rune, the next one up the ladder
rune_dawnbinding:Keeps: nothing - only the new rune comes out
rune_oathfire:Name: Oathfire
rune_oathfire:Recipe: 3 identical Tier V runes + 2 Radiant jewels
rune_oathfire:Result: the next Tier V rune up the ladder (the runes and jewels are used up)
rune_oathfire:Makes: 1 Tier V rune, the next one up the ladder
rune_oathfire:Keeps: nothing - only the new rune comes out
rune_turning:Name: Rune Turning
rune_turning:Result: 1 random other rune of the same tier, never a higher one (both runes are used up)
rune_turning:Makes: 1 random OTHER rune of the same tier
rune_kindlings:Name: The Six Kindlings
rune_kindlings:Recipe: one of each of the six Tier I runes
rune_kindlings:Result: 1 random Tier III rune (the six runes are used up)
rune_kindlings:Keeps: nothing - only the new rune comes out
rune_breaking:Name: Rune Breaking
rune_breaking:Recipe: 1 rune of Tier II to V + a Rough jewel
rune_breaking:Result: 2 of the top rune of the tier below it (the rune and the jewel are used up; red runes do not break)
rune_breaking:Makes: 2 runes of the top kind of the tier below it
rune_breaking:Keeps: nothing - only the 2 runes come out
rune_red_turning:Name: Red Rune Turning
rune_red_turning:Recipe: 3 red runes of any kind + a Radiant jewel
rune_red_turning:Makes: 1 red rune, the one you chose
rune_red_turning:UsesUp: the 3 red runes and the jewel
rune_red_turning:Keeps: nothing, only the chosen red comes out
jewel_polish:Name: Jewel Polishing
jewel_polish:Result: 1 jewel of the same family, one cut finer (the 3 jewels are used up)
jewel_polish:Makes: 1 jewel of the same family, one cut finer
jewel_prism:Name: The Prism
jewel_prism:Recipe: an Ember, a Frost and a Storm jewel of one cut
jewel_prism:Result: 1 Prism jewel of that cut (the 3 jewels are used up)
jewel_kindle:Name: Jewel Kindling
jewel_kindle:Recipe: 2 identical jewels (Rough to Faceted) + a Tier III+ rune
jewel_kindle:Result: 1 jewel of the same family, one cut finer (the jewels and the rune are used up)
jewel_kindle:Makes: 1 jewel of the same family, one cut finer
jewel_cleave:Name: Jewel Cleaving
jewel_cleave:Result: 2 jewels of the same family, one cut rougher
jewel_cleave:Makes: 2 jewels of the same family, one cut rougher
jewel_turning:Name: Jewel Turning
jewel_turning:Result: 1 random jewel of the same cut, any family, never finer (the 3 jewels are used up)
jewel_turning:Makes: 1 random jewel of the same cut, any family
jewel_pressing:Name: Rune Pressing
jewel_pressing:Result: 1 random jewel, one cut finer than the runes' tier (the 3 runes are used up)
jewel_pressing:Makes: 1 random jewel, one cut finer than the runes
jewel_pressing:Keeps: nothing - only the jewel comes out
jewel_binding:Name: Jewel Binding
jewel_binding:Recipe: 4 jewels of one cut (Cut or finer)
jewel_binding:Result: 1 random rune of the jewels' tier (the 4 jewels are used up)
jewel_binding:Makes: 1 random rune of the jewels' tier
jewel_binding:Keeps: nothing - only the rune comes out
item_oathmark:Name: Oathmark
item_oathmark:Recipe: a rare + a Tier V rune + a Radiant jewel
item_oathmark:Result: the same rare with one more socket past its limit (up to 2); its mods stay
item_oathmark:Makes: the same rare, 1 socket past its limit (up to 2)
item_oathmark:Keeps: every mod, base, level, socketed rune
item_socket:Name: Socket Boring
item_socket:Recipe: a magic or rare weapon, body armour, helmet or shield + any rune + any jewel
item_socket:Result: the same item with one more socket (magic up to 2, rare up to 1); its mods stay
item_socket:Makes: the same item, 1 more socket (magic up to 2, rare 1)
item_socket:Keeps: every mod, base, level, socketed rune
item_reforge:Name: Family Reforge
item_reforge:Recipe: a rare + 3 jewels of one family
item_reforge:Result: the rare with ALL its mods rerolled, one sure to be of the jewels' family; base, sockets and level stay
item_reforge:Makes: the rare, ALL mods rolled new, 1 of the jewels' family
item_imbue:Name: Family Imbuing
item_imbue:Recipe: a plain white weapon or armour + 3 jewels of one family
item_imbue:Result: a magic item of the same base, one mod sure to be of the jewels' family
item_imbue:Makes: a magic item, 1 mod of the jewels' family
item_awaken:Name: Awakening
item_awaken:Recipe: a magic item + 2 jewels of Cut or finer
item_awaken:Result: a rare of the same base and item level; all its mods are new
item_awaken:Makes: a rare of the same base, all mods new
